tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Page background. Parchemin by day, Veillée for a dim table at night.

tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: stat blocks, cards, sheets, list rows.

tokens.name: vellum-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: filter chips, selected tab, input wells. Only ink and ink-muted text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, numbers, icons. 11:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels under numbers, metadata, secondary text. 4.7:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Suppressed or replaced values (always with a strikethrough), disabled text. Use on parchment and vellum only.

tokens.name: garnet
tokens.usage: The identity colour: headings in small caps, primary buttons, links, selected states.

tokens.name: on-garnet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a garnet fill (primary button).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The red rules above and below stat blocks and section titles. Graphic only, never text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and unchecked toggles (3:1 or more).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Averages of dice (~148), epic markers, derived highlights. Text 5:1 or more on parchment and vellum.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Team-created content: the Équipe badge and its outline.

tokens.name: seal-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the Équipe badge.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text on seal-fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid state: synced, prerequisite met, formula valid.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: prerequisite lost, slot restriction broken, no slot of that level.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the element. Blue so it never reads as garnet.

families.display: "IM Fell English SC", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Character name on the web sheet. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Character name on mobile, page titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Stat block and section titles, in garnet.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Small-caps labels under saves, tab names.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Effets numériques ×4, y compris les buffs.
styles.usage: Descriptions of feats, spells and powers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, list rows, buttons.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines, in ink-muted or gilt.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: Timestamps and legal text only. Never for numbers.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about (attack, a breakdown total).

styles.name: formula
styles.usage: Formulas and entity ids in the content editor.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a number and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on web; between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page regions.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; specimen margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, stat blocks. The book has nearly square corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and provenance badges only.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines (hairline colour).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Red rules framing a stat block (rule colour).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width.
